description:
1. Disable unnecessary actuator endpoints using management.endpoints.web.exposure.exclude=env,logfile,heapdump
2. Enable Spring Security with proper authentication for actuator endpoints
3. Configure actuator security via spring.security.user.name and spring.security.user.password properties
4. Restrict actuator access to specific IP ranges or internal networks only
